context.transcript:
Welcome to Weston Sports Stadium.
We are very pleased that you're joining us here for this special event.
Tonight is the first time our hometown baseball team is playing in the regional championship.
To celebrate, we'll be giving away prizes throughout the night.
Our first prize goes to attendees who are in seats 23 through 30.
They will each win a free ticket to a game next season.
We'll announce more giveaways as tonight's game progresses.
And don't forget to stay after the game.
There will be a fireworks display.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎来到韦斯顿体育场。
我们很高兴您参加本次特别活动。
今晚是我们家乡棒球队首次参加区域冠军赛。
为了庆祝，我们将整晚派发奖品。
我们的第一个奖品颁给坐在23到30座的与会者。
他们每个人都将赢得下赛季的一张免费门票。
随着今晚比赛的进行，我们将宣布更多赠品。
别忘了在比赛结束后留下。
届时将有烟花表演所在。
